outfits.name: House Party
outfits.prompt: A 22-year-old Black man with warm dark brown skin and a lean, wiry 5'10" frame shaped by years of boxing. His hair is cropped in a tight fade with subtle waves on top, and deep brown eyes sit beneath heavy, expressive brows, a faint scar nicking his left eyebrow. He wears a black long-sleeve henley fitted close to the body with the top three buttons undone, dark olive chino pants, and scuffed white Nike Air Max sneakers. A thin gold chain rests at the base of his neck, and a woven leather bracelet wraps his right wrist. He stands with his weight settled on his left leg, the right slightly bent, one hand tucked casually into his pocket while the other holds a red Solo cup loose at his side, his head tilted just barely, shoulders easy.

outfits.name: Pier Dinner (Double Date)
outfits.prompt: A young Black man in his early twenties with warm dark brown skin, standing at a lean five-foot-ten with a wiry athletic build shaped by years of boxing. His hair is cropped in a tight fade with subtle waves on top. His eyes are deep brown, heavy-browed, and rest in a calm, searching gaze. A faint scar nicks his left eyebrow. His face is angular with strong cheekbones and a relaxed jaw. He wears a clean white button-down shirt worn open over a fitted black crew-neck tee, the button-down's sleeves rolled once at the cuff, the fabric a crisp cotton. His chinos are dark khaki, pressed with a visible crease down the front of each leg, cut slim through the thigh and tapered to the ankle. A slim brown leather belt threads through the trouser loops with a small brushed-metal buckle. His shoes are brown leather casual sneakers with flat laces and a low profile, clean soles. A thin gold chain sits tucked just inside the black tee's neckline, resting against his collarbone. He stands in an easy, grounded stance with one hand tucked loosely into his front trouser pocket, his weight settled on his back leg, the other foot slightly forward. His shoulders are relaxed and level, his chin tilted just barely down, and his head turns a few degrees to one side as though he's taking in whoever's across the table from him.
